title: Owner D Trajectory Record
description: Stable core schema for Phase 2 trajectory retrieval and prompt-safe memory.

scenario_id.description: Stable scenario identifier for deduplication and tie-breaking.

family.description: Family bucket such as F1, F2, F3, or F4.

tag.description: Original task tag such as single-answer or multiple-answer.

branch.description: Branch name defined by Owner B; use unknown instead of empty.

serving_sinr.description: Serving SINR scalar used for retrieval.

serving_rsrp.description: Serving RSRP scalar used for retrieval.

best_neighbor_advantage.description: Best neighbor minus serving signal advantage.

neighbor_in_config.description: Whether the relevant neighbor already exists in configuration.

mainlobe_outside.description: Null means no usable mainlobe evidence, not false.

mr_count.description: Count of MR or equivalent evidence rows.

tool_sequence.description: Ordered tools used or recommended in the trajectory.

key_evidence.description: Prompt-safe evidence phrases explaining why the case is reusable.

target_role.description: Role of the target object rather than an answer code or exact cell id.

confidence.description: Strength and applicability of the trajectory as reusable memory.
